notes: role=publisher: ebus-utility-meter-sim publishes a single energy.ebus.device.utility-meter device (no eBus-modelled children; per-phase measurements are property-name suffixes -a/-b/-c/-n). info, meter and status are always present; grid, doe, price, demand and power-quality are published when the meter has the corresponding signal. SCAFFOLD: these pins record what the device model DECLARES, not yet what this package publishes -- the emitter is not built. The vendored reference at examples/utility-meter targets data model 0.3 against a document that has since moved to devices/utility-meter.md and reached 0.6, so it must not be read as evidence of conformance. Tighten these pins to what is actually published, and add a catalog-drift guard in the shape of ebus-panel-sim's tests/test_catalog_drift.py, as the emitter lands. Known upstream inconsistency at 0.6: the ASCII device tree omits `price` while the prose beneath it counts price among the optional five, and the device-type registry agrees with the prose; file upstream before building against the tree.
